subject: BlueLine POC: Operational wins + brief publish ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@bluelineanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: BlueLine POC: Operational wins + brief publish ask

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for running the evaluation with us. The team at BlueLine was thoughtful in their test plan and we captured some clear operational wins that other customers in retail analytics will find relevant. Quick highlights from the 14-day POC (high level):

- Average end-to-end inference latency reduced from ~230ms to ~95ms (58% reduction) for the 512-token batched queries you ran.
- Per-request cost (token compute + network) dropped by ~3.1x after enabling caching and switching to the quantized variant we recommended.
- Throughput: sustained 4x higher concurrent throughput at the same GPU reservation during peak synthetic workload.
- Quality: human-eval pass rate on the 120-sample verification set stayed at 92% (no meaningful drop).

We put together a one-page summary for internal and external use — attached as a stub below. If you're comfortable, we'd love to publish a short customer note (one paragraph + logo) and include a 10–15 minute on-record quote from someone on your product/ops team. Our ask is intentionally small: a single-sentence pull-quote about the impact, and permission to cite the metrics above.

Attachment: [attachment: blueline_poc_onepager.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]

Could you let me know if BlueLine is open to: 
1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can use in marketing (we can draft), and
2) A 10–15 minute call next week to approve wording and logo usage?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 15: 10:00–10:15 or 14:00–14:15
- Wed Jun 16: 09:00–09:15

If those don't work, tell me a time that does and I’ll send a short invite. Thanks again — this was a great collaboration.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@bluelineanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: BlueLine POC: Operational wins + brief publish ask

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the clear summary and the one-pager. The metrics look right from our end; the ops team was impressed with the latency and cost delta. Happy to help — we can provide a short quote and approve the one-pager.

For the quote, here's a quick draft you can use or refine: 
"Working with Redwood reduced our inference costs by more than 3x and made sub-100ms latency attainable for our typical queries, which materially improved downstream throughput."

I'm also available for a 10–15 minute sync to finalize wording — Tue Jun 15 at 10:00 PST works for me. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Product Operations | BlueLine Analytics
priya.kapoor@bluelineanalytics.com

Priya — thank you, that draft is fantastic and succinct.

I went ahead and drafted a one-sentence attribution we can use (feel free to edit on the call):

"BlueLine Analytics partnered with Redwood Inference to reduce inference unit costs by over 3x while achieving sub-100ms median latency for production-style queries, enabling us to scale throughput without additional hardware."

I attached the one-pager with the quote inserted as a callout; if that wording looks good we'll publish the short customer note and request a logo file (PNG/SVG) for display.

Attachment: [attachment: blueline_poc_onepager.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]

I've scheduled a 10-minute blocker on the 15th at 10:00–10:10 PST — invite should arrive from my calendar. If you prefer slightly more time, we can expand to 15.

Rishi / Grace — tagging you both to ensure the quote aligns with legal/policy guidance and to coordinate a short asset publish flow (logo file, name + title, and preferred short attribution). If either of you want to adjust the quote tone before the call, please do so in-thread.

Thanks again,
Marissa
